sources.title: PLaMo 3 Translate - a pfnet Collection - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: PLaMo 3 Translate: translation-specialized LLMs (0.8B / 2B / 8B / 31B) in BF16 and quantized formats (FP8, W4A16, W4AFP8, NVFP4, GGUF, MLX-4bit).

sources.title: PLaMo 3 Translate: World-Class Translation with Open Weights—Here’s How ...
sources.snippet: Overview We have released the weights for PLaMo 3 Translate, our translation-specialized LLM, on Hugging Face. The models come in four sizes—0.8B, 2B, 8B, and 31B. Even the smallest 0.8B model outperforms existing translation-specialized LLMs, including models with more than 30 times as many parameters, in Japanese–English translation and translation between Japanese and other languages ...
